thread:
marie (product): Quick sync — planning to ship a self-serve burst guardrail UI for Dedicated customers so they can tune burst limits and preemption sensitivity per-reserved-pool. Need alignment on launch criteria, SLO tradeoffs, and which infra concessions we accept.

devon (eng): +1. What exact knobs are we exposing? Is it just max_burst_qps and preempt_threshold? Also: will the autoscaler accept per-pool overrides or only a central policy?

marie (product): MVP knobs: 1) soft_cap_tokens + hard_cap_tokens (soft can permit occasional overrun) 2) preemption_sensitivity (low|medium|high) 3) optional fallback_model. Must be configurable per-reserved-pool via API and console.

izzy (design): I can mock console cards. UX question: show estimated cost delta when changing soft cap? That requires billing hook. If we show it, need clear copy for "estimated".

tess (solutions): Customers will want a safety preview: "if I set soft cap X, how will my p95/p99 latency change?" Can we provide a backend estimate or a simple heuristic?

sam (sre): We can provide ballpark latency deltas using recent telemetry windows. Need: 7d history of per-pool QPS + tail latencies. We should include confidence bands. Also: add alert if preempt rate spikes after changes.

devon (eng): Implementation notes: add PoolConfig table + API endpoints. Autoscaler will read per-pool overrides when feature-flagged. Risk: per-pool hysteresis increases autoscaler state and memory. We'll gate with feature flag and gradual rollout to small percent of pools.

marie (product): Proposed launch criteria (MVP):
- API + DB schema for PoolConfig (CRUD)
- Console UI to edit three knobs with tooltips and an "estimate" area (placeholder if billing not ready)
- Autoscaler honors soft_cap and preemption_sensitivity when flag is on
- Audit logs + RBAC: only pool owners/org-admins can edit
- Telemetry: 7d QPS & p99 per-pool; expose sample traces for pilots
- Canary: 3 pilot customers in US region

devon (eng): +1. Call out required tests: regression/perf tests for autoscaler with per-pool hysteresis. Load tests: burst admission across 2k simulated pools and churn tests.

sam (sre): Ops checklist: rollout window, rollback playbook, runbooks for preempt-rate alerts. SLO: no >=1m placement regressions for pilot pools. Alert if preempt_rate >5% sustained for 5m.

tess (solutions): I'll shortlist pilot customers—prefer those with predictable diurnal patterns and an assigned SE. We'll own first-line support for 2w then hand to CS.

izzy (design): Draft tooltip for "preemption sensitivity": "How quickly opportunistic capacity will be reclaimed under contention. High = aggressive eviction to preserve core capacity; Low = conservative eviction preserving long-lived sessions." Thoughts?

devon (eng): Good. Internally preemption_sensitivity maps to numeric hysteresis and backoff parameters. We'll publish mapping in API docs.

billing-bot: FYI: billing needs a usage preview endpoint to compute estimated monthly delta for soft cap changes. We'll propose a minimal contract.

devon (eng): Example API payload for review:
```
POST /v1/pools/:pool_id/config
{
  "soft_cap_tokens": 150000,
  "hard_cap_tokens": 200000,
  "preemption_sensitivity": "medium",
  "fallback_model": "redwood-small-v1"
}
```
Responses should include applied_at, who_updated, feature_flag_state, and preview_cost_cents_per_month when billing provides it.

marie (product): Acceptance tests (high-level):
- CRUD via API + console persists and shows in audit logs
- Autoscaler respects soft cap & sensitivity in FF path (validated by token admission counts)
- Cost preview within 10% for test traffic once billing endpoint wired
- RBAC enforced on API and Console actions

sam (sre): Add monitoring: expose a dashboard for pilot pools showing admitted tokens vs cap, preempt events, and tail latencies. Set default alerts for anomalies.

devon (eng): Schedule: prototype of API + DB + mapping table in 3 sprints. Console + billing integration + design polish in additional 2 sprints. SRE testing runs in parallel.

marie (product): Prioritization note: a customer committed to fund a pilot if we can deliver in 6 weeks. Tradeoff: we may shift one infra perf spike item to Q3. Proposal: accept pilot runway and earmark resources.

izzy (design): I'll drop mocks by EOD Friday. Devon, confirm FF name so I can annotate mockups.

devon (eng): Feature flag: pool_burst_guardrails_v1. Default off. We'll check flag in autoscaler read path.

marie (product): Next steps: 1) devon to create RFC for PoolConfig schema + autoscaler mapping 2) billing to propose preview endpoint contract 3) izzy mockups 4) sam to draft canary runbook 5) tess to shortlist pilots. Sync Friday 11am.

marie (product): tagging: @devon (eng) @sam (sre) @izzy (design) @tess (solutions) :rocket:
